notes.title: Patch 6.1.1 Difficulty Selection Bug Hotfix
notes.content:
It came to our attention awhile ago that there is a bug that occurs with some users that prevents the difficulty selection menu from popping up after selecting your crew. After extensive testing we can't seem to replicate or find anything that might cause this.

So to help out those users that do have this problem, we have put in a cheat to skip the difficulty selection menu. 

After choosing your crew hold LEFT SHIFT + C and then press 1,2,or 3 to play on casual, normal, or hard difficulty respectively. 

DO NOT use the cheat before selecting a crew, as this may cause you to load in without any colonists.

Hope this helps!

Cheers,
Cameron

notes.title: Patch 6.1: Bugfixes and Energy Changes
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Just released a new patch, 6.1! Here's whats new:

[list]
[*]The game should now support 21:9 aspect resolutions. ("New Game" appears behind the title screen and some superfluous text is cut off on the research tree but otherwise good to go.)
[*]The base power system has been overhauled. Beyond being more balanced, operational costs for modules now only apply when performing a task in that module and don't scale off of the level of the module. This way if you start to run out of power, you can always stop your base tasks and not use any power.
[*] Power is now generated separately from use once you get a tech module. The recharge is constant +x power/sec depending on upgrades. Some research tree upgrades have been changed to reflect this.
[*] The map screen should no longer cut off on some resolutions
[*]Colony Experience earned from base tasks has been reduced somewhat
[*]Building the final specialization buildings on Candor will now take the proper amount of time.
[*] Filtering Ice at the water tanks will now consume power
[/list]

Mac build should be available soon.

Cheers,
Cameron

notes.title: PeriAreion Patch 6.0! MSEPS!
notes.content:
Greetings Mars Fans!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7921054/51404b98ce12ab0427d11ef9345b29f2484ed0ef.png[/img]

After a bit of a break for other projects, we're back with update 6.0! We have had this one 99% done for a while, but spent a bit longer on testing to make sure that everything is good to go. 

Here are the major changes.

POIs and Missions
[list]
[*] New Inventory System. Colonists can now pick up/drop equipment and samples.
[*]MSEP equipment. The tech module task "Communicate with Earth" has been replaced with "Build MSEP". An MSEP, or Mars Surface Experiment Package, can be deployed at experiment sites to gain funding
[*]POI system overhaul. POI/Assignments have been removed and replaced with a new sample, data, and experiment sites. These sites are based off current and purposed science experiments for Mars and utilize three different mechanics: Data Collection, Sample Collection, and MSEP Deployment.
[*] Events from the "Communicate with Earth" task have been added to the random event pool.
[*] All sites can now be discovered while driving the rover, albeit at a reduced range.
[/list]
Balancing
[list]
[*]Tasks now cost additional resources and take longer to complete but rewards have been scaled to accommodate.
[*]Cancelled tasks now refund their cost.
[*]Radiation and Frost effects now damage colonists regardless of time of day.
[/list]
Maps
[list]
[*]Map edges and sky boxes have been cleaned up/replaced.
[*]The map screen HUD has been simplified and darkened
[/list]
Audio
[*]Button feedback has been added to a range of buttons including HUD, research menu, building tree, PeriAreipedia, and pause menus.
[*]Colonists now play a mining sound while they work.
[*]Music volume has been scaled back.
[/list]
HUD
[list]
[*]A new alert overlay on the map button will appear while a weather condition is in effect.
[*]Sustainability objectives will now be displayed  in the to right corner after choosing a colony specialization, allowing players to more easily track their progress towards winning the game.
[*]Added a new end-game victory cinematic.
[*]The old landing site images have been updated.
[/list]
BUGS
[*]Fixed a bug where the base specialization would not correctly unlock the winning conditions
[*] Cleaned up some mineral spawns on Hellas that would spawn out of the play area.
[*]The starting splash screen has been debugged and added back into the game.
[*]Clicking “Back” while having a landing site selected will now correctly close the landing site rather than take you to the main menu.
[*]Colonists portraits no longer flash red when not taking damage or inside a module.
[*]Building sites on Mawrth and Hellas should now spawn in the correct locations.
[/list]

notes.title: Future Updates
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Hope you are enjoying the new PeriAreion update!

We wanted to keep you apprised of plans for future work on PeriAreion. Now that the bulk of the overhaul is complete and we are happy with the art style, we can focus on a few things we left out before and some new/expanded gameplay.

Here is a list of a few things we want to do. This is in no way a definitive list of every feature we are adding but just what we are thinking we can accomplish on top of our other work at the moment.

[list]

[*] free base building system. We want you to place buildings where you want and choose how your base looks. We had this half functioning VERY early on but scrapped it when it was proving difficult to get any farther.

[*] astronaut customization. definitely the ability to change suit colors so you can identify people easier. perhaps custom naming and stat re-rolling

[*] POI overhaul. Right now you just interact for funding. Some require a base return or additional sites but we want to beef up this system to add a bit more gameplay and feel like you're doing science.

[*] pickup/drop system. We want to give astronauts the ability to pickup and drop items. This could include picking up samples, grabbing care packages, moving equipment into position, etc.

[*] new research upgrades based on the added content.

[*] Optimization Tweaks. Because I had never programmed before this game and was learning at the time, the coding is a big ball of hot mess (better since the update) but I could get it to run on a toaster if I wanted to now. Just need the time.

[/list]

We will try to schedule our next major content patch here in a few weeks. All depends on other work load. As always we will continue to fix bugs as they are reported to us.

Cheers,
Cameron

notes.title: PeriAreion 5.0.9 Patch Notes (Repost)
notes.content:
Just need to re-post the 5.0.0 update notes for admin reasons.

Here's whats new: 

[list]

[*] New 3D art! Modules, colonists, terrain: everything just looks better. 
[*] In-game popup video tutorials that are hopefully both quicker and more enlightening than the separate tutorial level/walls of text in the original game. 
[*] Usability. Complete overhaul of user interface. 
[*] Replaced the old “drag and drop” system of getting colonists to perform tasks inside modules. Now, nearly all activity happens outside in the game world rather than in confusing menus with lots of tabs. Just click on a module to see the tasks your colonist can perform within it. 
[*] Less micromanaging. Colonists will now perform certain tasks continuously until they run out of resources or are ordered to stop. 
[*] Refill air without leaving your EVA suit! Colonists can now pop by the lander to top up their air. 
[*] Dual Rovers. You can now unlock a second rover from the research tree. 
[*] Teamwork added accidentally! Due to a bug, Colonists can now work together to mine a resource node. This functionality was 100% unintentional but since we always wanted it that way so we left it in. 
[*] New navmesh and better pathfinding for colonists. 
[*] New portraits for all colonists. Tilde still looks like a man, though. 
[*] New colonist model and new animations, including a more dramatic death animation. 
[*] New voices for the Chinese, Australian, German and Jamaican colonists thanks to some amazing volunteers. Also, new credits thanking said volunteers. 
[*] Completely new HUD-- now 94% less confusing than original HUD! 
[*] A new resource, “Parts”. A general term for components your colonists can manufacture using in-situ resources. Used to repair broken bits on modules and equipment. The Geology module now has the main task “Manufacture Parts” rather than the ability to repair other modules (which never made much sense). Repair is now an additional option in the module task menu for each respective module. 
[*] New improved models and textures for all modules. No more “handpainted by a small child on an ipad” aesthetic. 
[*] Terrain textures on all maps have all been repainted and normal mapped to make the terrain appear more realistic than before. 
[*] ICONOGRAPHY FOR EVERYTHING! Colonist abilities, resources, research tree, maps… you name it, we’ve made an icon for it! 
[*] New map screens, now accessible through a compass at the top of the screen. 
[*] Rebalanced research tree upgrades. 
[*] The rover no longer moves on its own or stalks people. We think.

[/list]

If you encounter any other issues, please let us know! Contact us at admin@tbagames.net, or via our website.

[*] The memorial will now correctly spawn after the first colonist dies.

[*] Ling is now memorialized with the proper name.

[*] Ice node totals increased by 50% to help with balancing.

[/list]

notes.title: Patch 5.0.0 Notes
notes.content:
We just finished uploading the Mac and PC builds of PeriAreion 5.0.0. Here's an idea of the improvements we have made:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7921054/7db8453257eb395658d848c0cc282f369ea28709.png[/img]

[*] New 3D art! Modules, colonists, terrain: everything just looks better.
[*] In-game popup video tutorials that are hopefully both quicker and more enlightening than the separate tutorial level/walls of text in the original game.
Usability. Complete overhaul of user interface.
[*] Replaced the old “drag and drop” system of getting colonists to perform tasks inside modules. Now, nearly all activity happens outside in the game world rather than in confusing menus with lots of tabs. Just click on a module to see the tasks your colonist can perform within it.
[*] Less micromanaging. Colonists will now perform certain tasks continuously until they run out of resources or are ordered to stop.
[*] Refill air without leaving your EVA suit! Colonists can now pop by the lander to top up their air. 
[*] Dual Rovers. You can now unlock a second rover from the research tree.
[*] Teamwork added accidentally! Due to a bug, Colonists can now work together to mine a resource node. This functionality was 100% unintentional but since we always wanted it that way so we left it in.
[*] New navmesh and better pathfinding for colonists.
[*] New portraits for all colonists. Tilde still looks like a man, though.
New colonist model and new animations, including a more dramatic death animation.
[*] New voices for the Chinese, Australian, German and Jamaican colonists thanks to some amazing volunteers. Also, new credits thanking said volunteers.

[*] Terrain textures on all maps have all been repainted and normal mapped to make the terrain appear more realistic than before.

[*] New map screens, now accessible through a compass at the top of the screen.
[*] Rebalanced research tree upgrades.
[*] The rover no longer moves on its own or stalks people. We think.
[/list]

[list]
[*] PeriAreipedia Gameplay Articles are still being finished/dropped in so some are locked at the moment. All the science articles are in.
[*] The info box at the bottom left hand of the screen sometimes stays up when it should not be up. Mousing over any HUD button or environment object should fix that.

[*] Missing SFX on some of the UI/environment objects, audio pass is on the list of to-dos
[*] We're reworking the cutscenes and still adding some animations to make landing, receiving payloads/colonists from Earth, and winning/losing more exciting and less anticlimactic. 
[*] When Ling dies her name still shows up as "Pang" on the memorial
[/list]


If you encounter any other issues, please let us know! Contact us at admin@tbagames.net, or via our website.

notes.title: PATCH 5.0.0 IMMENENT!
notes.content:
Hey Mars Fans!

Sorry you guys haven't heard from us in a while, we have been super busy with all sorts of projects not least among them, the complete overhaul and rework of PeriAreion! 

I know it has been a long time coming but we got a contract working on some games for NASA and had put some of the PeriAreion patchwork off. Additionally we increased the scope of the changes to PeriAreion because we were not happy with leaving some stuff in there the way it was.

So this patch will touch on everything. Graphics wise, the whole game has gotten a fresh coat of paint. Every environment texture has been redone and every model has been remade and painted. These new models have ambient occlusion, spectral, normal, and diffuse with reflection probes so they should look a lot more realistic and more along the lines of the art style we originally wanted but couldn’t do because we didn't know how.

The 2D art has all but been replaced with a brand new HUD. The HUD is easier to access at the top of the screen, cleaner, and neatly displays resources on the left, rations on the right, and your map/build/research buttons in the middle. The colonist portrait along with the return to base button and a new cycle colonist button have moved to the bottom right corner. We have also added a permanent stats display button to see colonist stats.

The notification system and information display has been reworked. Now all information you will need about pretty much everything will appear in the bottom left corner along with the action you can take. Notifications are smaller and will no longer interfere with the HUD and will display until dismissed. All text is now legible at any resolution.

We have added support for all aspect ratios without the pillar boxing we had in before. So play in glorious 16:9 to your heart’s content.
The ant artic training tutorial is now gone. It has been replaced with an in-game tutorial notification system that can be toggled on/off from the options menu.

The biggest gameplay changes come with the addition of parts as a resource. Parts are used to repair other modules and manufactured from the geo module. The base screen is gone, you now interact with your base from the outside by right clicking any module and selecting a task to perform.

The Rover no longer has any limit on number of colonists on board and must be driven by a colonist at all times. The unmanned rover research upgrade has been replaced and will now spawn a second rover. Additionally the rover will not spawn until you build a level 2 Geo module changed from level 1.

New voices have been added for the Chinese colonist, Jamaican colonist, and German colonist with voice actors matching those accents. We will hopefully get a full complement in there eventually but for now you have less repeated voices.

Other changes include new colonist select screen, pause menu/periarepedia HUD reworks, notification animations, cloud system, skyboxes, and color corrections.

Known issues right now: the PeriAreipedia. Obviously since we changed everything the gameplay articles don't match or are entirely irrelevant. Hopefully we can get those fixed before we release but that might have to be a later update since it does not affect gameplay at the moment.

We are testing right now and making tweaks. We have an event on the 9th where we will be presenting the game, so we would like to be released shortly after, although we will not release until we are completely satisfied that everything has been tested and is working.

Cheers,
PeriAreion Development Team

We just wanted to give a quick update on the status of the latest (and greatest) PeriAreion patch! 

This is going to be our biggest patch yet, overhauling key gameplay mechanics, implementing a new HUD, and updating almost all the art of the game. The main reason we are doing this is that the skills of our team have grown tremendously over the last few months and it only felt right to put in the time to use some of these abilities to improve our first and favorite game. 

Here are some improvements we have been making:

Texturing
Every model in the game is getting a shiny new coat of paint.

Gameplay
Most importantly we are making gameplay changes to address feedback and hopefully make everything a little more intuitive

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7921054/4293262f4f0e620eed2e0273e895caeb3d230df5.jpg[/img]

We will be posting more about the changes (especially the gameplay ones) as we get closer to the release of the patch. We have had to move the launch back about two weeks due to work running over on another project but we expect to have the patch done by the end of June. As always we are VERY excited to release this update but we want to take our time and make sure that it is properly tested and polished.

We will keep you posted!

Cheers,
PeriAreion Development Team

notes.title: One Year on Steam and New Patch!
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone!

We wanted to take the time to express our heartfelt gratitude to all of you who helped support our little indie studio by buying PeriAreion.

Unbelievably, it's been a full year since we released on Steam, and a lot has changed since then!  To celebrate, we have several exciting updates planned for the next couple of months, so stay tuned. Thank you all for your patience!


Also...New Patch!! Here are the changes:

1) Rover Mode: Rover mode has been completely reworked. The Rover is only drivable in third person but now dynamically drives over the terrain. This is something we always wanted to do but due to the complexity of the physics involved we were limited to our psuedo-rover mode. The main reason for this change is to reduce the complexity of the rover programming and simplify the movement systems. Additionally, the portraits of colonists inside the rover now show up in the upper right-hand corner when rover is selected, and colonists can be unloaded individually by clicking the new "unload" buttons under the portraits. 

2) POI Mouseovers added: the new tooltip mouseovers for the POIs have been added to the game.

3) POI Bug fixes: A medley of random issues with POIs on different maps have been fixes. There might still be some issues we are working on but these should by no means be recurring bugs.

4) Display Glitches: Fixed an issue with some of the GUI displaying when it was not supposed to. Still have some bits to fix on the mission failed screen.

We're excited to be working towards some new content (and polishing old content) in the next few months. We're currently doing some contract work to enable us to work full-time at the studio, and this gives us a little extra time to work on improving PeriAreion even more. It's been a crazy year, and we've not had nearly as much time to devote to PeriAreion as we would have liked (due mainly to working several part-time jobs)-- but the support of all of you who bought, played, or gave feedback on our game has kept us going!


All the best,
PeriAreion Development Team

notes.title: Patch 4.1.5 Live for PC and Mac (Known Issues List)
notes.content:
Greetings all!

It's been a crazy week, but we've released a patch for Mac and PC that addresses some more bug fixes. We had the opportunity last weekend at Otronicon to subject our new tooltip system to strenuous testing and user feedback. We are now working on refining the tooltips to make sure that they are as useful and informative as possible and, most importantly, don't get in the way quite so much.

All in-base tasks should now be working, but there are some known issues that we should be able to get to in the next few days.

Known Issues:

-- Modules will not display when they are broken making tasks appear to not work, though repairing with a full repair cycle them should fix it

-- Loading a game may sometimes load the incorrect map, causing building and mineral placements to be off.

-- The rover tends to move on its own (especially on Mawrth Vallis) making locating it troublesome at times... not to mention a little creepy.

-- PeriAreipedia Articles unlock incorrectly and continue to display the "PeriAreipedia Unlocked" GUI permanently

-- Failing a game continues to display base GUI and loading Icon over the load video

-- Some POIs are not interactable and need new mouseovers


Thank you all for bearing with us as we continue to improve the game! We welcome any feedback, and look forward to bringing you the next patch very soon. 

Thanks,
PeriAreion Development Team

notes.title: Update 4.0.0 Now live! (PC)
notes.content:
Hello Mars Fans!

It has been a while but we have been working hard to improve PeriAreion and are proud to release patch 4.0.0. This is our most comprehensive patch yet, a lot of bug fixes, overhauling systems for optimization, and retooling animations and textures. Here is a list of some of the changes.

OPTIMIZATION TWEAKS: PeriAreion was our first title, something we made while learning to program/etc. With that in mind the coding was far from efficient which translated into larger lag times. We have reworked nearly every script to run faster and reduce lag.

NEW COLONIST MODEL: The Colonist model has been completely redone to match the suits on the select screen. Additionally, we have added new animations for working, idle, death, and walk.

NEW BUILDING TEXTURES: We have been updating the building texture slowly to improve them and clean up their appearance. Most noticeable are the connectors between the modules which now have an entirely new model.

NEW COLONIST VOICE: We have been working on getting the voice actors we need to put in an international team. The first of this slow rollout, Australia, has been done and is in the game.

NAV MESH FIXES: The navigation system has been overhauled and should no longer cause pathing errors. We are still working on the click through feature for when the camera is behind terrain but for now your colonists should instantly go where you tell them.

ICON UPDATE: The in-game icons that identify intractable world objects have been converted from GUI to 3D Models. This should give a more accurate representation of where the object is in the world.

MAP SCREENS: The map screen has been changed to accommodate a new HUD. This is part of a larger visual reworking for the HUD that we wish to continue when we get time.

CURSOR SPEED:
BUG FIXES: We addressed as many bugs as possible (Thank you to Mark for sending a comprehensive bug list!) Here are a few

Empty ice spots will no longer spawn when starting a saved game.
Fog color/time of day will properly load when loading a saved game
Colonist will no longer die while in the rover
Colonists will no longer sometimes be invisible on exiting the Rover
Reaching sustainability will now properly play the ending movie/credits
Stopping your colonist from mining will no longer stop the tutorial from advancing
Fixed a bug where some POIs/Assignments were not completing properly
Indicators on the research tree should now instantly update to reflect availability
Fixed a bug where a research option might show as “locked” when otherwise not
Fixed a bug where the observatory would be invisible after being built
Module malfunctions will now stop all tasks in that module (except repair) as intended
Spectroscopy will now reveal all the resource map locations as intended

We hope you all enjoy the new patch. Over the next few days we will be releasing the Steam version and getting a DRM free version out to our backers. Our next areas of focus are a complete debugging of achievements, addition of new voiceovers, and updates to the module textures.

Thanks,
PeriAreion Development Team

OPTIMIZATION TWEAKS: PeriAreion was our first title, something we made while learning to program/etc. With that in mind the coding was far from efficient which translated into larger lag times. We have reworked nearly every script to run faster and reduce lag.

NEW COLONIST MODEL: The Colonist model has been completely redone to match the suits on the select screen. Additionally, we have added new animations for working, idle, death, and walk.

NEW BUILDING TEXTURES: We have been updating the building texture slowly to improve them and clean up their appearance. Most noticeable are the connectors between the modules which now have an entirely new model.

NEW COLONIST VOICE: We have been working on getting the voice actors we need to put in an international team. The first of this slow rollout, Australia, has been done and is in the game.

NAV MESH FIXES: The navigation system has been overhauled and should no longer cause pathing errors. We are still working on the click through feature for when the camera is behind terrain but for now your colonists should instantly go where you tell them.

ICON UPDATE: The in-game icons that identify intractable world objects have been converted from GUI to 3D Models. This should give a more accurate representation of where the object is in the world.

MAP SCREENS: The map screen has been changed to accommodate a new HUD. This is part of a larger visual reworking for the HUD that we wish to continue when we get time.

CURSOR SPEED:
BUG FIXES: We addressed as many bugs as possible (Thank you to Mark for sending a comprehensive bug list!) Here are a few

Empty ice spots will no longer spawn when starting a saved game.
Fog color/time of day will properly load when loading a saved game
Colonist will no longer die while in the rover
Colonists will no longer sometimes be invisible on exiting the Rover
Reaching sustainability will now properly play the ending movie/credits
Stopping your colonist from mining will no longer stop the tutorial from advancing
Fixed a bug where some POIs/Assignments were not completing properly
Indicators on the research tree should now instantly update to reflect availability
Fixed a bug where a research option might show as “locked” when otherwise not
Fixed a bug where the observatory would be invisible after being built
Module malfunctions will now stop all tasks in that module (except repair) as intended
Spectroscopy will now reveal all the resource map locations as intended

We hope you all enjoy the new patch. Over the next few days we will be releasing the Steam version and getting a DRM free version out to our backers. Our next areas of focus are a complete debugging of achievements, addition of new voiceovers, and updates to the module textures.

Thanks,
PeriAreion Development Team

notes.title: Update 2.4.1
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone!

Small patch to hopefully fix some bugs that have been reported. We have tested and could not verify these bugs but we did make some changes to the code based on our best situation:

Fixed and issue where the min and max values of ice in a drill spot were reversed. This may have been the cause of an issue where spots were yeilding zero ice.

Removed the delay on unloading Colonists from the rover. The idea here was to eliminate the possibility for error during the short delay as the rover played the sound/particle effects of unloading a colonist and when the rover actually spawns the colonist. We hope this will prevent issues of disappearing colonists.

Added a reset to the colonist's action state upon entering the rover. Hopefully this might prevent instances where a colonist exiting the rover will reenter instantaneously leading the errors.

The weather station will now correctly spawn everytime after completing construction.

More to come! We will dedicate as much time as we can going forward to ensuring we get more updates, fixes, and gameplay out to you guys!

Thanks,
TBA Games

notes.title: Update 2.4.0
notes.content:
Happy Easter Everyone!

Update 2.4.0 is now live for PC. The mac version will be along soon. Here are the changes we have made:

Added a return to base button below the colonist portrait. Now you can easily send colonists back to the base for air refills. Right now it has some difficulty with paths from the farthest corners of the map but we have found it still brings your colonist to within 10 feet or so of the lander if not all the way.

The memorial screen should no longer continue to display if you click during the death animation.

Fog starting distance during dust storms has been adjusted to prevent duststorm "blackouts" at night. While maybe a bit realistic to be stumbling about in the dark we realize that this can be frustrating.

Additional code has been added to ensure that colonists should no longer take damage from anything except sickness/injury while in the rover or in the base. Please let us know if this is still happening.

Airlock sounds now scale properly with SFX volume

The landing cutscene volume now correctly scales off of SFX rather than Alert volume.

The Rover Map icon has been changed to differentiate it from colonists.

The research tree now no longer claims you recieve a second rover for building the level 4 geo lab.

Trade funding effect will no longer be active before researching trade.

There are still reports of the rover disappearing, though we have been unable to find this issue in our testing. It might have been linked with the rover colonist damage bug we patched today. 

Hope you all enjoy and as always keep that feedback coming!

Cheers,
TBA Games.

notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Patch 2.2.0 is now live for PC. Some things we've changed:

Fixed an issue where colonists would walk into terrain/get stuck if you switched between a "bad" destination and "good" destination too quickly. While this is a preliminary fix and does not eliminate the problem entirely, we manage to increase the response time on path comparisons reducing the liklihood of the bug happening.

Dust storm and airlock particle effects have been updated.

Increased the amount of mineral nodes that spawn on normal and casual difficulties. This should make it a bit easier to find the minerals you need.

Modules have been updated to a more complex shader with better reflection mapping.

I hope these fixes didnt break anything...our testing time was a bit limited. So let us know if there are any new issues that crop up.

Sorry this patch took a while, our programmer became ill after travelling and has been recovering from that. We will be getting started on another content update soon. Now that navigation has been somewhat adressed, our focus is on the expanded options menu and alternate base configurations/spawn locations on each map. We are also aware of a bug that shows research icons as simultaneously "locked" and "available for purchase" sometimes. Working on that.

Thanks for all your support, you guys are great!

-TBA Games

notes.title: What we are working on...
notes.content:
Hello all!

First of all, thanks to everyone who has given us feedback. With a QA team of two, it's often hard to catch every bug in a new build, but we're working to address issues that we may have missed. A quick heads-up on features we're planning on incorporating into the next major patch:

Map Pings. We want to add a marker you can place by clicking the map screen. This will give you a point of reference when navigating the map, especially in the rover. We are also looking into adding a probe that the user can control that can drop beacons for navigation.

New loading screen. As we mentioned in a previous update, we have replaced the loading video with a non-moving image for the moment as we test out better-looking alternatives.

Improved rover functionality. Yes, the rover is hell to drive and we have hated that. With a programing team of one, the rover physics have been the single largest issue during development.  We will give it another crack and see about adding an in-rover map as well.

Expanded options menu. This is something we can do, just havent had the time (again, one programmer!). The main focus here is the expansion of the graphics slider into a full and detailed menu.

Bug fixes. Always and ever present, gonna keep working on 'em.

Also, we're in the process of finalizing the art for trading cards and badges, so those should be available in the next few days. 

Cheers,

-TBA Games
